channel.description: Latest alerts from Kenya Meteorological Department

item.title: Heavy Rainfall Advisory issued on 23rd October 2026
item.description: Moderate to heavy rainfall exceeding 20 mm within 24 hours is expected from 24th to 28th October 2026, with peak intensity between 26th and 28th October, with rainfall intensity projected to decrease by 30th October 2026.
item.author: director@meteo.go.ke (Kenya Meteorological Department)

item.title: Large Waves Advisory issuedon 23rd October 2026
item.description: Ocean wave heights exceeding 2 metres are expected along the Kenyan coast on Sunday, 25 October 2026.
item.author: director@meteo.go.ke (Kenya Meteorological Department)

item.title: Strong Winds Advisory
item.description: Strong southerly to southeasterly winds exceeding 25 knots (12.5 m/s) are expected over coastal, eastern and northern regions of the country from 24th to 28th October 2026, accompanied by moderate to heavy rainfall in several areas.
item.author: director@meteo.go.ke (Kenya Meteorological Department)

item.title: Heavy rainfall advisory
item.description: Moderate to heavy rainfall exceeding 20 mm within 24 hours is anticipated
item.author: director@meteo.go.ke (Kenya Meteorological Department)

item.title: Heavy Rainfall Advisory
item.description: The rainfall being experienced over several parts of the Highlands West and East of the Rift Valley, and Central Highlands including parts of the Southeastern Lowlands is expected to intensify to more than 20mm in 24 hours, from 8th to 14th May 2026. The intensity is expected to peak between 10th and 13th May 2026 and spread to parts of the Northwestern sector. The heavy rainfall is anticipated to decrease in intensity from 14th May 2026. Although the intensity may reduce toward the end of this period, rainfall is still expected to continue in the Lake Victoria Basin, Highlands West of the Rift Valley, the Rift Valley, Highlands East of the Rift Valley and Central Highlands (including Nairobi).
item.author: director@meteo.go.ke (Kenya Meteorological Department)
